title: Which circuit will Formula One announce as the replacement venue for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix?
background: The Bahrain Grand Prix originally scheduled for April 2026 was cancelled amid conflict in the Middle East.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Formula One's first official announcement after May 1, 2026 identifying a replacement host circuit for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix. 
  Resolution Conditions : The announcement must occur by December 31, 2026. Resolution is based on the announced venue, regardless of whether the race is subsequently held or receives final regulatory approval. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the circuit.
